Società Sportiva Arezzo is an Italian association football club based in Arezzo, Tuscany. The club was formed in 1923, refounded in 1993 after going bankrupt and refounded in 2010 after being unable to enroll in the tournament. The club will play in Serie B, the second tier of Italian football in the 2026–27 season, following promotion from Serie C.
